How it works

Four steps from payment request to ZAR.

01
Create payment
The merchant enters the ZAR amount. ABC Pay generates a secure payment request with a fixed quote.
02
Display QR
A QR code is presented at the till or online checkout. The customer scans it with their wallet app.
03
Customer approves
The customer reviews all payment details: merchant, amount, network, destination, and expiry.
04
Receive confirmation
Both the customer and merchant see a clear payment result in this frontend demonstration.

For Customers

Scan. Review. Pay.

Use stablecoins you already hold to pay at any ABC Pay merchant. Every detail is shown before you approve — nothing hidden.

Scan the merchant's QR code
Open any compatible wallet app and point your camera at the payment QR.
Review all payment details
Merchant name, ZAR amount, stablecoin equivalent, network, and quote expiry — all confirmed before approval.
Approve the payment
Tap approve in the demo to see the intended customer confirmation experience.
